artifact.title: Programm zur Wahl des Berliner Abgeordnetenhauses - Wahlprogramm Berlin 2026

ledger_metadata.zero_approval_basis: All available Berlin stock was inventoried. BE-IMPACT-2026-03 explicitly covers Volt Once-Only and deemed-approval instruments and is preserved verbatim on overlapping atoms, but it does not provide the complete atom-level field set required for EXPLICIT_FACH_APPROVED. No other stock record binds a complete required Fach field set to an exact byte-pinned Volt page/block/atom. This is an object-level inventory result, not a blanket evidence rule.

segmentation_contract.extractor: PyMuPDF 1.28.0 text-layer blocks; all pages rendered with Poppler 26.07.0 at 70 dpi for visual completeness review
segmentation_contract.block_order: native PDF content-stream block order; repeated exact header/footer furniture separately counted and excluded
segmentation_contract.source_unit_rule: one visually bounded text block; only lowercase cross-page body continuations are joined; box, table-of-contents, heading, small-print and imprint blocks remain explicit context units
segmentation_contract.atom_rule: policy-bearing terminal-punctuation sentence; semicolon, explicit new-subject coordination and safely identifiable coordinated independent action verbs split; same-verb object lists and causal/purpose clauses remain bound
segmentation_contract.classification_rule: effect-bearing only for explicit collective commitment, target/modal, enumerated measure or policy-actor action; headings, contents, diagnostics, history, Best-Practice examples, slogans, imprint and page furniture are context
segmentation_contract.excerpt_rule: whitespace-normalized PDF text-layer excerpt up to 280 Unicode code points; complete normalized source-unit and atom text retained and SHA-256 pinned

field_policy.reviewed_not_assessable: Every RNAA atom carries object-bound text, class-specific minimum missing inputs and a unique exact reason. Partial explicit stock is preserved verbatim only where the source object states the matching instrument.
